correctness.rationale: Direct row reduction yields a paired-node confluent Vandermonde with exact d^k and q^beta factors; positive product for every 0<q<1 implies invertibility. Log derivative has a strictly increasing positive right side crossing beta exactly once; both endpoints of the determinant vanish. Uniform Riemann-sum convergence and nonzero limiting derivative prove c_k=c*+O(1/k) and finite horizon. A standalone exact rational checker replays 16 determinant instances, plus finite root and numerical-integral checks. Distinguishes finite testing from infinite proof.

value.rationale: For linearly observed decaying multimode systems, existence of a reconstruction map does not control information volume or determine a sampling horizon. The theorem provides a sharp entire-dimensional solution of a natural constrained information-determinant problem, including a unique optimizer and a universal spectral-gap-scaled finite horizon even as mode count grows. The bound has immediate use for designing and benchmarking mode-amplitude estimation, and is not just a known-table recomputation; the restricted sensor and noise assumptions delimit its applicability.
